# Make

Make is a platform that allows users to automate workflows by connecting various apps and services.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/make/.

## Actions

- **Get Operations**: Retrieve all operations.
- **List Enums Languages**: Retrieve a list of language codes and names.
- **List Enums Timezones**: Retrieve a list of timezone codes and names.
